newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sapura eyeing stake in UMW.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sapura eyeing stake in UMW.

text.p: Sapura Holdings Bhd said on Thursday it was eyeing a stake in vehicle concern UMW Holdings Bhd held by state investment fund Permodalan Nasional Bhd.
Group managing director Shahril Shamsuddin was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as saying that the company had made a proposal to the authorities.

He told reporters after the underwriting ceremony of Sapura Holdings' 52.8 percent subsidiary, Sapura Motors Bhd, that the company has "various options for the proposed acquisition", but did not elaborate. Sapura Motors is seeking a listing on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board.
The market has been abuzz with rumours that Sapura was offering to acquire 32 percent of Permodalan Nasional's total equity interest of about 45 percent in UMW, for 13 ringgit a share.
Sapura executive chairman Shamsuddin Abdul Kadir said the company had not received any feedback from the government after submitting the proposal in October last year.

Shahril said the proposed acquisition would create synergy for Sapura Motors, which is involved in the manufacture of metal based products and high-value precision products for the automotive industry.

UMW makes a wide range of light and heavy equipment for use in the industrial, construction and agricultural sectors. It also assembles and markets passenger and commercial vehicles and related spares.
UMW shares closed at 12.00 ringgit on Thursday, up 20 cents.
